stages.name: Directory Database and Signing Key Theft

scenario.summary: Attackers exploit an authentication bypass in the VMware vCenter Directory Service (CVE-2026-123890) to retrieve SRP session keys and impersonate administrators without passwords. This access is leveraged to exfiltrate the directory database and forge administrative assertions, which are then used to create local superuser accounts and enable SSH for root-level command execution.

hunt.name: vCenter Appliance Administrative Tampering and Root Access
hunt.description: This hunt identifies post-exploitation activity on VMware vCenter Server Appliances following an authentication bypass. It looks for the use of management APIs to create administrative local accounts and the enablement of SSH or the Bash shell. It correlates these management plane changes with OS-level execution logs where an attacker typically joins the 'superAdmin' group and uses sudo to spawn interactive root shells. By stack-counting these events across the appliance fleet, the hunt separates legitimate maintenance from targeted tampering.

config.content: SELECT url_path, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS host_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen, MAX(time) AS last_seen FROM hb_http_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{api_paths}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(url_path) || ',') > 0 OR LOWER(url_path) LIKE '%/api/appliance/access/%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY url_path HAVING host_count <= 2 ORDER BY host_count ASC
config.description: Detect rare or unauthorized use of the appliance configuration APIs that enable SSH or create accounts.
config.expected_signal: An API call used on one or two appliances, suggesting non-standard maintenance. Normal activity typically appears fleet-wide.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, raw_record, time FROM hb_linux_audit WHERE record_type = 'EXECVE' AND ( (LOWER(raw_record) LIKE '%useradd%' AND instr(',' || LOWER('{{persistence_groups}}') || ',', ',superadmin,') > 0 AND LOWER(raw_record) LIKE '%superadmin%') OR (LOWER(raw_record) LIKE '%sudo%' AND LOWER(raw_record) LIKE '%/bin/bash%') ) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')

config.objective: Determine if the rare API calls to management paths and the OS-level user/shell modifications confirm unauthorized tampering. Contrast against the software inventory to ensure these are production vCenter hosts.
config.description: Assess whether the management API calls and OS-level commands together indicate a post-exploitation chain.
config.expected_signal: A detailed verdict per host citing the correlated activity.
config.success_criteria: A verdict of malicious | suspicious | benign for each host, citing the API paths and audit record command lines.

config.question: the triage verdict is malicious for at least one host
config.condition: the triage verdict is malicious for at least one host
config.description: Drive automated containment for high-confidence hits and analyst review for ambiguous signals.
Prevent further management plane commands or data theft by isolating the vCenter appliance.
config.instructions: Isolate the vCenter appliance and revoke all active administrative API sessions and SSH keys.

config.description: Perform deeper analysis to identify the origin of the bypass and the full extent of tampering.
config.instructions: Examine the vmdir logs for unexpected SRP verifier creation. Verify if any directory database copies were granted before the account creation. Reconstruct the attacker's shell commands from /var/log/audit/audit.log.

config.description: Ensure the appliance is updated and the vulnerable configuration is addressed.
config.instructions: Verify that the appliance has been updated to the fixed version (e.g., 8.0 U3m). Confirm that all local accounts created during the intrusion have been deleted.

config.description: Record the hunt results and update baseline exclusions for legitimate vCenter administrators.
config.instructions: Archive the forensic findings. If any benign activity was found, update the hunt parameters to exclude the authorized administrative source IPs.
